summary: Can-Fite BioPharma filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 9, 2026, announcing publication of a peer-reviewed case report in the Japanese Journal of Gastroenterology and Hepatology on Namodenoson in decompensated cirrhosis. The single patient achieved ascites resolution, variceal regression and roughly 28 months of clinical stability before successful liver transplantation in January 2026. No securities transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation or closing date is involved; the filing is a routine foreign-private-issuer disclosure of clinical news with no special-situation or risk-arb angle.
